messages.content: In dana/utils/dummy_math.py, update divide_numbers to handle zero division by raising ValueError('Cannot divide by zero'). Once edited, run pytest tests/utils/test_dummy_math.py using your verification tool. If the test fails, inspect the traceback and fix it automatically before presenting your final answer
The **`divide_numbers`** function now safely handles division by zero by raising a `ValueError` when the divisor is zero. All tests, including `tests/utils/test_dummy_math.py`, now pass successfully.
